text:
jun: heads-up: onboarding sample app failing for a customer. Python SDK embeddings call returns 1536-d vectors but curl against REST returns 768-d.

rachel: oh no. which SDK version and code?

jun: @rachel using redwood-python v1.2.0. code:
```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
vec = client.embeddings.create(input='hello world')
print(len(vec[0]))
```

jun: prints 1536. curl to REST:
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello world"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
```

jun: prints 768. client mismatch causes downstream cosine similarity mismatch in our sample app search.

amir: that sounds like a default-model drift. REST server recently defaulted to embed-lite (768) to reduce cost, but Python SDK defaulted to embed-v2 (1536) after generator got new model aliases. We should be explicit about model param in SDK.

rachel: but that shouldn't silently change length. SDK should either mimic REST default or document the new default prominently. Also noticed SDK retry behavior: when embeddings endpoint returns 429, SDK immediately retries in a tight loop for seconds (no exponential backoff), which triggered CI flakiness.

ci-bot: test redwood-python/tests/integration/test_embeddings.py failed on main (rate limit errors).

amir: ack. two fixes: (1) align SDK default model to server default or require explicit model arg; (2) implement standard exponential backoff with jitter and cap retries for 429/503. Also add integration that asserts embedding length consistent with REST when using same model param.

jun: workaround for the customer: call REST directly or pass model='embed-lite' to SDK. sample app patch: https://github.com/redwood/sample-search/commit/ab12cd34

rachel: can you add a short repro script for CI so we don't regress?

amir: will open PR. plan: change default in 1.2.1 to match server, add param docs, add retry/backoff logic, and add integration tests that run against staging endpoint. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/redwood-python/pull/111

ci-bot: opened issue RNF-2410 in redwood-python 1 is failing builds due to retry tight-loop.

jun: timeline? customer needs search working by Wed.

amir: I'll push a small patch to enforce model param parity and bump retry policy. targeting hotfix 1.2.1.patch. Running unit + integration locally now.

rachel: QA checklist: verify embedding lengths for default call against staging REST, assert backoff pauses between retries, run sample-search end-to-end.

amir: added metrics: log retry_count and last_status_code to client debug logs so we can spot tight loops.

devx-bot: release note draft: "Fix: Python SDK embedding default now matches server default (embed-lite) and improved retry/backoff for rate limiting to prevent tight-retry loops." Scheduled for 1.2.1.

jun: confirmed sample-search works with explicit model param. will notify customer and update onboarding guide.

rachel: follow-up: add a small section in SDK docs about "model default changes" and a migration note. I opened docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/223

amir: PR merged to staging, integration tests pass, releasing 1.2.1-rc.1 to npm/pypi test.

ci-bot: CI green on staged branch.

jun: thanks all. leaving notes in sample app issue: https://github.com/redwood/sample-search/issues/12

devx-bot: thread archived.
